_comment: The bot's fixed-wording templates (brief §75): sentences the answering model is told to use, found as sentences in 200+ answers and 50+ conversations. redact_feed.py records which an answer carries; make_usage.py counts them per day (answer-templates-daily.csv). Configuration, not citizen text.

templates.pattern: for the most up.to.date information, please visit
you can read more on the citizens information (?:website|page)
to get accurate and up.to.date guidance
contact your local citizens information centre
call the citizens information phone service
for example, are you asking about:
i'm sorry, i couldn't find specific information about this topic in the citizens information content available to me

i'd be happy to help with that\.
